theta_e.method: arc radius from the deflector centre

system.description: The green arrow marks the deflector, a compact yellow early-type galaxy at the centre. The cyan arrow points to a tight blue arc curving around its southern side at about 1.5" radius; the magenta arrow marks a brighter knot on the north-western side of the same ring, most likely a merging-pair image. The curvature is centred on the deflector and the arc is bluer than the lens. Dashed circles mark field galaxies and dotted circles stars to mask in the fit.
